'''Garrick Orion''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Nova Orion Station]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was one of the two founders of [[Nova Orion Industries]], along with his old friend [[Jonas Nova]]. However, sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], they nearly [[Nova Orion Crisis|split the organization]] due to their growing mutual suspicion and distrust.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Garrick Orion appeared as a non-player character in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
